chunksmith_modern_gui.panel.title: %s Command panel
chunksmith_modern_gui.hint.safety: Only use this if you are sure the panel misjudged your permissions/commands
chunksmith_modern_gui.hint.cancelTrimWin: Only clickable during the 3s window after the range is sent
chunksmith_modern_gui.status.missing: ChunkSmith not found: put it in mods/; tick “Ignore prerequisite check” if the server has it
chunksmith_modern_gui.status.rejected: Not ready: server does not know /%s command, or the prerequisite mod is missing
chunksmith_modern_gui.status.treeReadonl: Server /%s is available, but you have no admin rights (start/trim need admin)
chunksmith_modern_gui.status.treeMissing: Prerequisite is installed server-side, but the command tree lacks: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.status.notDispatch: Server did not provide /%s command: the mod is missing server-side, or you are not an admin
chunksmith_modern_gui.status.localNoTree: Prerequisite %s installed · waiting for the command tree to sync…
chunksmith_modern_gui.status.noTree: Did not see /%s command: the mod may be missing server-side, or you are not an admin
chunksmith_modern_gui.gen.coords: Center X / Z (used with custom coords)
chunksmith_modern_gui.gen.radius: Main / second radius (chunks; star requires it, oval optional)
chunksmith_modern_gui.gen.preview: Command preview (click a line to edit; this is what runs)
chunksmith_modern_gui.gen.previewManual: Command preview (edited by hand; this is what runs)
chunksmith_modern_gui.task.tip1: The panel only shows progress; it never starts generation by itself.
chunksmith_modern_gui.task.tip2: When the prerequisite reports “no running task”,
chunksmith_modern_gui.task.tip3: the task is marked as finished automatically.
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.warn: Trim deletes chunks outside the selected area and cannot be undone.
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.warn2: Double-check world, center and radius before running.
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.center: Center of the kept area (inside is kept)
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.coords: Center X / Z (used with custom coords)
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.radius: Keep / second radius (chunks; star requires it, oval optional)
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.cmdsNote: Sends the range setup first; /%s trim is auto-sent only if it is not rejected within 3 s
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.phase1: # Stage 1: set the range (stage 2 runs only if not rejected within 3s)
chunksmith_modern_gui.trim.phase2: # Stage 2: sent only if the server reports no error
chunksmith_modern_gui.heat.empty: No data yet: click “Fetch heatmap” on the right
chunksmith_modern_gui.heat.legend.gray: Grey = exists but outside the shape
chunksmith_modern_gui.heat.legend.gold: Gold = inside the shape, not generated yet
chunksmith_modern_gui.heat.note1: Data comes from the save region file headers,
chunksmith_modern_gui.heat.note2: no chunks are loaded and the server is unaffected.
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.heatPrereqMiss: Prerequisite missing, but the heatmap still tries to read the local/server save.
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.noServerSide: The server does not have the panel's server-side part; the heatmap needs server support.
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.setsLoadFailed: Failed to read the set backup history: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.setsSaveFailed: Failed to write the set backup history: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.heatDenied: Heatmap request rejected by the server: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.server.heatPerm: Requires server permission level 1 or higher
chunksmith_modern_gui.server.heatCooldow: Too many requests, try again in a few seconds
chunksmith_modern_gui.server.heatBusy: Server is busy scanning, try again later
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.trimIgnorePrer: “Ignore prerequisite check” is on: the trim command-tree check is skipped; the server rejects it if unsupported.
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.resendFinal: Range was not rejected by the server, resending %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.rollbackTimeou: Rollback confirmation timed out: %s = %s (the command may already have applied; the backup entry was restored, you can try again)
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.setTimeout: set confirmation timed out, no backup recorded: %s = %s (the change may have applied, but the panel cannot confirm it, so it cannot be rolled back)
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.rollbackReject: Rollback did not take effect, backup entry returned to history: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.setRejected: Setting did not take effect, not recorded as a backup: %s = %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.log.serverErrorOnR: The server reported an error while handling the range setting
chunksmith_modern_gui.cfg.author: Author BarryAlen777
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.world: World name may only contain letters, digits and _ - .
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.radius2: Second radius must be between 0 (unused) and 1000000
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.centerX: X coordinate is outside the world border
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.centerZ: Z coordinate is outside the world border
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.star: Star needs a second radius (greater than 0, not exceeding the main radius)
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.starMax: The star's second radius cannot exceed the main radius
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.trimRadiu: Keep radius must be between 1 and 1000000
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.trimStar: Trimming a star needs a second radius (fill it in below: greater than 0 and not exceeding the keep radius)
chunksmith_modern_gui.validate.trimStarM: The trim star's second radius cannot exceed the keep radius
chunksmith_modern_gui.preview.errRoot: The preview has lines that do not belong to /%s: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.preview.errWorld: invalid world argument (letters, digits and _ - . only): %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.preview.errRadiusI: radius argument is not an integer: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.preview.errCenterR: center coordinates are outside the world border: %s
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.noPrereq: ChunkSmith prerequisite not found, install it first; if it is installed, tick “Ignore prerequisite check”
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.noPerm: Not enough permissions (admin required). If you are sure you are an admin, tick “Skip safety checks” on the Generate tab
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.cancelSent: Cancel sent; the server needs one more confirmation, click “Confirm cancel” below
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.localCleared: Local state cleared (the server-side job is untouched)
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.safetyOn: “Skip safety checks” enabled: permission and parameter checks are bypassed, double-check commands yourself.
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.previewResto: Preview restored to follow the form
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.genParamsCha: Parameters changed, this start was cancelled; click “Start generation” again
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.twoPhasePend: The previous two-stage command is still awaiting server confirmation, wait a moment
The previous two-stage command is still awaiting server confirmation, wait a moment
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.opPending: The previous action is still awaiting server confirmation, please wait
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.rangeGenSent: Setting the range; generation starts on its own if not rejected within 3s and aborts on errors
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.rangeTrimSen: Setting the range; the trim is sent automatically if not rejected within 3s, click “Cancel pending trim” to stop it
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.tooFast: Just sent; wait a moment before clicking again (avoids duplicates)
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.trimPending: The previous trim is still awaiting server confirmation
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.trimCancelle: Cancelled: this trim will not be sent
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.noDispatch: The server did not provide the /%s command: the mod may be missing, or your account has no admin rights; if you are sure, tick "Ignore prerequisite check"
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.noPermTrim: Not enough permissions (admin required). If you are an admin, tick “Skip safety checks” on the Generate tab.
chunksmith_modern_gui.toast.rollbackSend: Rollback failed to send (not in a world?), backup entry restored
chunksmith_modern_gui.treeMissing: missing from the server command tree: %s
